Commentary.Commentary: India are really going to have to apply themselves this time around, otherwise this game could be finished today itself. After the English innings ended and the groundstaff was clearing the deck, a lot of dust was seen puffing up. The home side has two spinners, compared to India's one, and they would attack the Indians relentlessly. The final innings will be starting shortly. Stay glued on here!

The game isn't over by a long shot, but England have their noses ahead in this game. It all resulted because of a culmination of some solid batting at the top by Jennings and Root, followed by Buttler's heroics with Stokes first and then Curran. The Indians couldn't take much advantage of the rough areas with Ashwin not looking at his best, but they will take heart in the face that if there wasn't much on offer for their pacers, then something similar might happen with their opponents too.

So it took India just 26 balls to wrap England up, conceding just 11 runs. Good for them too, as they were running the risk of conceding runs and having a target of around 300 to chase, given the way Sam Curran was going. Shami got Broad on the very first ball of the day and a needless run out ended things for the hosts. Still, setting a target of 245 isn't something they would mind much.

OUT! And India wrap up the England innings, pretty quickly. Some silly running has helped them achieve this though. Ashwin bowls a skidder angling in on Curran's pads. The southpaw goes for the pull but is late on the shot. The ball lands, skids through and hits his front pad and rolls past the slip fielder. Rahane at first slip cannot stop it cleanly and the batsmen take off for a run. With Ishant Sharma running in from third man, the batsmen look to steal another run and turn back for the second. May be Sam wanted to keep strike as this was the first ball of the over. The birthday boy picks up and flings a perfect flat throw right on top of the bails which Pant whips off in a jiffy. Curran puts in a dive but the umpire takes it up. Replays show that Curran is well short of his ground. ENGLAND FINISH ON 271 AND SET A TARGET OF 245 TO WIN.
Fires it in on Jimmy's pads who blocks it out with a dead bat.
Shami strays on his pads, Anderson keeps it out by defending from his crease.

Shami keeps this a bit short of a length around off, Curran shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The ball rolls towards the cover region and one run added to the total.
Plays the pull again to this short delivery angled in his body, still refuses the run.
Lands it on a length around off, Curran taps this towards the point region.
Shami bangs this one short, Sam goes for the pull, connects well, the ball goes to the fielder at deep square leg but Curran does not run. Taking responsibility.
Keeps it full but just outside off, Jimmy shoulders arms.
Tossed up just outside off, Sam leans forward and drives it through covers, the batsmen cross for a run.
Defends this slower fullish delivery off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, Sam blocks by coming forward.
Floated one on the off stump. Sam gets behind the line and defends.

FOUR! Ashwin starts off with a full straight delivery from over the wicket. Curran plays a lovely straight drive, past Ashwin's right. The timing and placement is near perfect as the ball races across the straight boundary.
Flicked away to square leg but no run taken. Wise from Jimmy.
Curran rotates the strike again. Flicks it through the gap in the mid-wicket region and gets to the other end.
Back of a length angling into the body, worked down to fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery well outside off, Anderson has a feel for it but misses.
Banged in short, it's quite sharp and accurate around off. Anderson just about manages to sway away from the line. He probably knows what he's in for.
Full and outside off, from around the wicket, Curran drives it sweetly through the covers. Reluctantly takes the single.
Beaten! Tossed up a bit outside the off stump. Anderson tentatively looks to block it out but the ball pitches and turns away. The spin beats Jimmy's poke and he survives.
Tossed up on the stumps, Anderson keeps it out from his crease.
This time Curran gets some bat on this floated delivery on his pads, gets a single to the square leg region. Jimmy comes on strike.
Tossed up on the off stump line. Curran comes forward and blocks it down.
Ashwin again fires it down the leg, Curran though tries to flick it this time but does not get any bat on it. Pant collects.
The offie starts on a wrong line, drifting down the leg side. Sam lets it go to Pant.
James Anderson is the last man in for England.

OUT! GONE! Perfect start for the visitors. India strike early. Shami is on a hat-trick for the second time in this innings. He lands it full and a bit wide of off stump. Broad, interestingly, tries to go for the big booming drive through covers. The ball lands and moves away slightly. The movement takes the outside edge and Pant behind takes a regulation catch. The Indians are elated and England have just one wicket remaining.

We are ready to begin. The umpires and the players make their way out to the middle. Mohammed Shami will finish his incomplete over from last evening and he will be bowling to the new batsman, Stuart Broad. One slip and a leg gully to start off proceedings. Here we go...

First and foremost, the visitors will look to wrap up the English tail as quickly as possible. With the young and talented Sam Curran still at the crease, the hosts would want their lead to go well past 250. Even 300 may be on the cards, given the way the young southpaw has displayed his class with the bat. Every run from now on will hurt the tourists like a needle but the most important thing is that the game is still not out of their reach. If they can manage to stay in the present and do the basics right, we are in for a captivating contest on our hands today.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 4, may be the deciding day of the 4th Test between England and India in Southampton. Another fascinating day of Test cricket awaits us with England 233 runs ahead and still having their last two wickets in hand. It's a bright and shining Sunday, a perfect day for cricket. So get your coffees and chips ready, as we are about to witness yet another enthralling contest unfold between these two mighty Test sides. After three days of grueling Test cricket, the game still hangs in the balance, or may be with a slight tilt towards the home team. With the conditions of the pitch, quality of the English spin attack and the fourth innings to come taken into consideration, it won't be incorrect if you say that India certainly have got an uphill task on their hands today.
... Day 4, Morning Session ...

The hosts have swelled their lead to 233 and they will want to stretch it as much as they can. India, on the other hand, will be eager to clean up the tail as soon as possible. The Englishmen have Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid in their ranks who can prove to be more than a handful with the pitch deteriorating. The visitors will be aware of that and they have to come out with the right mindset during their second essay with the bat in order to challenge the opposition. Join us on Day 4 at 1100 local (1000 GMT) to catch all the action. Till then, cheers!

The Indians toiled hard throughout. They were penetrative in the morning, especially when they took a couple of early wickets. However, Joe Root played a handy knock to take his side out of trouble, getting good support from Keaton Jennings. Mohammed Shami, Jasprit Bumrah and Ishant Sharma bowled well but the visitors needed their lone spinner, Ravichandran Ashwin, to rise to the occasion. The pitch had dried up considerably but the wily spinner didn't create much of an impact. As a result, the tourists couldn't take wickets at regular intervals.

This is a day which has belonged to England. They will be really pleased with their efforts. Their lower middle order has come through with flying colours once more. Jos Buttler and Ben Stokes were involved in a vital partnership and took England to safe harbours from a tricky situation. The former scored a fine fifty and though his partner failed to convert his start, the job was pretty much done as England's lead crossed 200 without much fuss. The star for them in the first innings, Sam Curran, is still out there and is guiding his side through.

OUT! Shami gets a 3-fer! He has been the most threatening among the Indian bowlers and has produced good results. Good length ball on off, shapes away a touch after landing. Rashid has no option but to play at it and gets a healthy edge behind. Pant moves to his right and takes a regulation catch. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 3!
Edged but safe! In the corridor of uncertainty, Rashid pokes at it and gets an outside edge. Rahane gets low at gully but the ball drops short of him.
On a length just outside off, Rashid plants his front foot across and makes a good leave.
Good length ball, straightening after landing. Curran pokes at it and gets an outside edge towards third man. A run taken.
In the channel outside off, Curran allows it through.
Looped up nicely outside off, some drift on this one. Rashid has to stretch forward and blocks it tentatively off the outer half.
Fuller in length, played off the outer half towards point.
Similar to the last ball and Adil is solid with his defense.
Rashid comes forward to the tossed up ball and dead-bats it.
Quicker through the air, Adil blocks it out somehow.
Quicker one on middle, Rashid hangs back to keep it out.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
Goes deep in the crease to the length ball and blocks it solidly.
Beaten! Short of a length outside off, Curran tries to glide it through backward point but fails to put bat on ball.
Good length ball around off, pushed off the back foot towards covers.
Short and there is some room on offer, Adil plays it with an open bat face towards point to rotate strike.
FOUR! Streaky but effective! Back of a length ball outside off, Rashid tries to punch it through the line but gets it off the outer half past backward point.
Curran goes deep in the crease to the length ball outside off and glides it down to third man for a single.
Bye! Down the leg side, Curran tries to glance it away but misses. Pant flies to his right but fails to gather it properly. A run taken.
On a length outside off, keeps a bit low. Sam crouches and blocks it solidly.
Good length ball, seaming away off the deck. Curran stands tall and punches it to the cover region.
Sprayed down the leg side, clipped uppishly towards long leg to rotate strike.
Back of a length ball, Adil gets behind it and answers it with a straight bat.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! A pretty safe shot! With the lead continuing to swell, India will be pretty worried. Short and room on offer, Curran flashes at it and gets it off the outer half of the bat over third man to pick up another boundary. 6 from the over.
Shortish ball around off, Curran punches it off the back foot to the cover region.
Good bowling! This one pitches on a length around off and straightens a bit to go past the hanging bat of Sam.

Tentative! Good length ball in the tight off stump corridor, staying low. Rashid is on his toes and has to crouch. Ends up getting a thick inside edge past his legs and towards fine leg. A single taken.
Dug in short, Rashid ducks under it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Sam punches it on the up towards mid off.
Mohammed Shami returns for his first stint with the second new ball.

FOUR! That is a shot which Rashid loves to play, states Nasser Hussain on air. Overpitched ball on leg stump, Adil clips it nonchalantly through square leg. The fielder in the deep hares across to his right but has no chance of cutting it off.
Fuller in length around off, Adil Rashid leans ahead to stonewall it.
Short of a length ball just outside off stump, Adil knows where his off stump is and makes a good leave.
It seems that Rashid is having a bit of an issue with his bat. He is taking his stance and checking it. Calls for a new bat.
Good length ball that takes off after pitching. Rashid rises up and fends it down.
Back of a length ball on the fifth stump channel, Adil camps back and punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Fullish ball around off, kept out watchfully.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Curran is playing another important knock. All these are vital runs for England. Pitched up ball outside off, Sam caresses it through covers to find the fence.
FOUR! Well played! Half-volley outside off, Curran strokes it nicely through mid off to pick up another boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Pitched up ball around off, driven crisply to mid off.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Adil Rashid strides out to bat.

OUT! Not dead but it is umpire's call which is good enough! England do not lose a review but they lose the dangerous Buttler. Sharma lands this one on a length in the avenue of apprehension from wide of the crease. After pitching, the ball seams in appreciably. Buttler shuffles a touch in order to flick it across but his head is not on top of the ball. Ends up missing it to get hit flush in front. Ishant and Co. rise up in a vociferous appeal and up goes the umpire's finger. The wicket-keeper batsman decides to challenge the decision straightaway. Is there an inside edge? Well, Snicko rolls in and shows no spike. Time for Hawk Eye. Impact is in line and it is clipping the top of middle and leg. The on-field decision stays. Another vital contribution from a lower order pair, 55 to be precise.
This can be a turning point in the game. Buttler has been trapped in front of the stumps but he takes the review quickly. Seems dead to the naked eye!

A good call eventually  from the youngster! He blocks the length ball past Sharma and calls his partner through. He is danging to the danger end as the fielder swoops in and has a shy but he makes his crease comfortably.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed towards cover-point for an easy single.
Pitches it up wanting the new ball to do something but there is no movement as such. Buttler defends it down the track.
Nicely done. Overpitched outside off, Buttler goes to the pitch of the ball and drives it square of the wicket on the off side. Will get a couple for doing so.
Shortish and it nips away after landing. Curran has space to work with and punches it to deep point to rotate strike.
Ishant Sharma comes in for a burst. Can he make the difference for India?
Short of a length ball, comes at a nice height to Jos who stonewalls it from within the crease.
Better from Bumrah! Angles this one on the fifth stump channel and the ball straightens a touch. Buttler points his bat skywards to let it go.
Pitched up ball around off, holding its line. Buttler with a high elbow blocks it.
Full ball, tailing in substantially. Buttler falls over a bit and misses his flick to get hit on the pads. No real appeal as it was doing too much.
Bumrah goes wider of the crease and angles in a length ball. Jos knows where his off stump is and makes an assured leave.
Back of a length ball, rising on Buttler. He hops and pushes it back to the bowler.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the new ball from the other end.

FOUR! This youngster has a lot of confidence! Tossed up outside off, Curran comes forward and drives it with authority through wide mid off to find the ropes. The 50-run stand comes up for the duo. The lead has gone past 200 too. The lower middle order has come to England's rescue once again.
The arm ball from Ashwin on middle and leg. Curran is late to get his bat down and is struck on the pads. There is a stifled appeal for an LBW but it dies down quickly. It was going down leg.
This one is tossed up nicely and dips a bit on Curran. He gets low and smothers the turn.
Fuller in length outside off, Curran leans ahead and defends it with authority.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shorter in length, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
The second new ball has been taken now. India need to make the most of it.
Mistimed but he gets a couple for it! Chops the shortish ball through extra cover and gets a good result for it.
Short of a length ball, leaving the southpaw. He glides it towards backward point.

A bit of hesitation but no harm done! Buttler taps the length ball besides the pitch on the off side. His partner calls him through for the single. He hesitates initially but then trusts Curran. Pandya attacks the ball and has a shy at his end but misses. Ashwin at mid on dives to his left to make a good stop. A single is the result.
Short ball which sits up nicely for Curran. He nails the pull to the deep square leg fielder for a single.
Back of a length ball on the hips, tucked to fine leg for a single.
A slower short delivery, doesn't come onto Buttler as he checks his pull shot to the mid-wicket fielder.
Full ball on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
A bit shorter on middle and leg, helped towards mid-wicket.
Quick through the air again, Curran brings his bat and pad close together to deal with it.
Full tossed up ball outside off, patted gently to the off side.
Gets right behind this quicker one and defends it nicely.
A bit risky but gets away with it! Sam exposes his stumps by making a bit of room as he chops this shorter ball towards covers.
This one pitches on a length on off and keeps low. Jos does well to adjust in his crease and defends it down the track.
Back of a length ball, defended solidly off the back foot.
Good length ball on middle and off, after pitching, the ball skids through. Buttler is hurried a touch but keeps it at bay by playing it towards square leg.

FOUR! Exquisite! Off cutter from Pandya on a fuller length outside off. Buttler comes forward and drives it beautifully through extra cover. The timing is spot on and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Jos puts his head down and defends it calmly.
On a driveable length outside off, might be tempting for a lot but Buttler is set now. He doesn't make a mistake of chasing it away from his body.
The carrom ball this time on middle, Curran reads it correctly and blocks it nicely.
Ashwin tosses this one nicely around off, Sam leans ahead and taps it towards the mid off fielder.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full ball outside off, Sam eases it off the front foot towards mid off.
Almost a similar delivery as Sam is solid as a rock and dead-bats it.
Stump-to-stump line from Ashwin, Curran comes forward and dead-bats it.
FOUR! Buttler is flowing like a river at the moment! Similar length ball outside off, Jos waits for it and guides it deftly through third man to find the fence.
Back of a length well outside off, glided down to third man to rotate strike.
Fractionally overpitched on off, driven on the up to mid off for a brisk single.

Back of a length ball in the tight off stump corridor, Buttler pushes at it with hard hands and gets it off the outer half through backward point. Jos calls his partner through for the second run and completes it with ease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A gentle length ball around off, played defensively towards mid-wicket.
Quicker one around leg stump, Sam clears his front leg and dead-bats it.
Full ball around middle and leg, kept out watchfully.
There is a bit of a delay. The physio comes out and attends to Pant. He might have hurt his throat actually. Let's hope he is fine.

That was a ripper! Pitches on a shorter length around leg and shoots off the deck with a good amount of spin. Curran prods forward to account for it but misses. The ball brushes his arms and goes behind. It is a tough take for Pant and he fails to gather it. The replays confirm that there was no bat involved.
Very full outside off, Jos goes for a booming drive but gets it off the outer half to third man. A run taken.

FOUR! Crisp! 9th Test fifty for Jos Buttler! Tossed up outside off, Buttler leans into it and strokes it through extra cover for a majestic boundary. He lifts his bat towards the crowd and gets a warm round of applause. He has played a fine knock and will want to continue in the same vein.

Pushed quicker through the air outside off, spinning in sharply. Buttler shuffles a touch and tries to block it but misses to get hit on the pads. A belated appeal from the Indians takes place but the umpire is unmoved. Perhaps the impact was outside off.

Drinks break! Time for everyone to get a break. India will like to see the back of Sam Curran as soon as possible, not underestimating Jos Buttler. Just a few overs to go before India take the new ball.
Full and around off, Curran shows the full bat face and bunts it down.
Played to the point region by Jos. One run added to the total.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and on off, Buttler defends it in front of him.
Short ball on leg, Curran pulls it away to the deep square leg fielder. They pick up the run and get to the 200-run mark. England lead by 173 runs.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Off spinner down leg, Curran defends it off his back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Two Byes. That's gone off the pitch. Hurled on off, the ball spins away from Curran who makes a good leave at the last moment. Pant fails to collect it as the ball rolls towards third man. They pick another brace.
Darts this on the pads, Curran flicks it away to the on side.
Full and on middle and leg, Curran flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder from the circle hares behind the ball to keep it to two.
Full and on middle, Buttler flicks it away through square leg in the gap. Enough time to come back for the second.
Overpitched outside off, Buttler drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Drags his length slightly behind, Buttler hits it to the off side.
Back of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Low full toss on that fourth stump line. Buttler hits it towards the mid off fielder.
Full and outside off, moves away a little. Buttler shoulders his arms to it.
On the pads again, Buttler works it around the corner to keep the strike.
Full and on middle and leg, Buttler hits it for the mid-wicket fielder to collect.
The rough doing its bit. Ashwin lands it there and Buttler fails to put bat on ball.
Dishes this outside off, Buttler strides forward looking to block it. The ball spins and hits his pads outside off.
Fuller ball around off, Buttler plays it onto the ground.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Not the best of lines. Hurls this down the leg side. Buttler tries to flick it but cannot get any bat to it.

Edged but falls short. It was a genuine edge but the soft hands from Jos saved him. Good length ball outside off, Buttler hangs his bat out. Gets a faint edge to it. The ball falls just short of Kohli at first slip.
Lovely cricket from the youngster. Full and outside off, Curran plays it with soft hands towards mid off and hares to the other end.
FOUR! Curran does not need an invitation. Sees this fullish ball outside off, he extends his arms and slices it through point for a good looking boundary.
Full and on the legs of Curran who flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Loopy ball on off, Buttler plays it onto the ground.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Darts this one quicker in line of the stumps, Curran this time is solid in defense.
Good from Ash. Gets the batsman to come forward. Pitches it on that rough, the ball spins and beats the outside edge of Sam who was ahead to block it.
Fuller in length on the pads, Buttler flicks it away towards square leg to rotate strike.
Short ball outside off, Buttler flicks it to cow corner and jogs back for the second run.
Similar length outside off, Sam can't find the gap as he cuts it to the short point fielder.
Back of a length ball around off, Curran stays inside and plays it to the off side.
Bouncer! Bangs this one short down leg, Curran ducks under it to evade it.
Length outside off, Buttler opens the bat face and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and on off, Buttler stays low and hits it to the off side.
Once again Buttler is beaten outside his off pole. Pandya hurls this on a good length outside off, Jos pokes at it as the ball moves away and misses his outside edge.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Better from Ashwin, in line of the stumps, Curran gets low to block it but the ball goes to the off side off the outer half of the bat.
Low full toss outside off, Buttler whips it through mid-wicket for just a run.
Darts this full again on the legs of Sam who flicks it away to cow corner for a run to get off the mark.
Full and on the leg side, Curran turns his bat to the on side.
Sam Curran comes out to bat. He was the star for England with the willow in their previous innings. Can he put in a similar performance?

OUT! That's a big, big wicket in the context of the game and it is Ashwin who has finally found a way! He switches to over the wicket and bowls a quicker one outside off. Stokes tries to jam it out but gets a thick outside edge behind. Rahane at first slip is sharp as a hawk and takes a fine catch. The 56-run stand has been cut short. The southpaw looks very angry with himself. He was playing quite well and he would be sad that he failed to convert it into a big one. Is this the opening India needed? They will certainly hope so. The hosts lead by 151 runs.
Full again around off, Buttler plays it with a straight bat.
Stays in his crease, covers his stumps and sees off this ball, tapping this in front of him.
Full and on off, Buttler gets forward and blocks it.
Short ball around off, Buttler looks to pull it but gets a bottom edge to it and it goes behind the stumps.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Buttler leans ahead and creams it through covers for another boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! 50-run stand between the two. England are going really well. Short ball from Ashwin on off, Stokes punches it off his back foot through covers for a boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by Jos. They pick up a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

NOT OUT! A review in desperation? Both India and England have been poor with their review. Ashwin bowls this full outside off, it keeps low after pitching on the rough. Buttler hangs his bat out but the bowl goes to Pant behind the stumps. He is the lone fielder appealing. Has a chat with Kohli and they take it up. Replays show us that there was no edge. India lose both their reviews.
Review time! It is regarding a caught behind appeal against Jos Buttler. Have India got it right?
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Another peach. Stokes pokes at it but fails to put bat to ball.
Good from Pandya. Hurls this one around off, the ball moves away a hint. Stokes looks to cut it but can't make any contact.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and on off, Buttler drives it towards the off side for one.
Starts by bowling one down leg, Buttler whips it away through square leg for a brace.
Hardik Pandya to bowl for the first time today and also in this innings. Just one slip in place for him. What does he have for us?
Darted this one down the leg side, Stokes goes after it but cannot make any contact.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and outside off, Stokes punches it off his back foot.
On the pads, flicked away to the square leg fielder.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.

Floated outside off, the ball spins into Jos. He prods forward and tries to block it. It touches something and goes to Rahane at first slip. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. No inside edge there and it was way outside off for an LBW.
Goes short again, Buttler pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Some chin music for JB. Bumrah bends his back and dishes out a bouncer outside off, Buttler lets it through to the keeper.
Full again closer to the stumps, Jos gets behind it and sees it off.
Full and on off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Delicate glance and will get a boundary for it. Back of a length ball on the leg side, Buttler helps it on its way and the ball races to the fence.
Shami did it 4-5 times to Buttler and now it's Bumrah. 'Beating the outside edge of Buttler'. Bowls it on a good length outside off, Buttler goes fishing and gets beaten.
On the pads again, looking to target that rough. Stokes whips it away through square leg for a brace.
Nothing from Ashwin. Trying too hard perhaps. Stokes stays inside and blocks this ball from around off.
On the leg side, worked towards square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another short ball on the pads, turned away to the on side.
Short ball down the leg side, enough time for Stokes to rock back and block it out.
Full again on the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for one.
Full and in line of the stumps, Stokes gets behind the ball and blocks it.
Back of a length around off, Stokes defends it off his back foot.
Saw Stokes charging down the wicket and digs in a good bouncer. Around off, Stokes sways away from it.
Drags his length back a tad on off, Buttler hops and tucks it away through square leg for one.
Low full toss on middle and leg, Buttler can't find the gap and plays it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Full and on the pads, worked to the on side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another loopy ball on middle and leg, Stokes hits it to the on side.
Tosses it up on off, Stokes is solid in defense.
Full and on leg, flicked away through square leg for another run.
Fuller ball on off, Stokes squeezes it towards mid off for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
Fuller ball coming back into Jos who turns his bat to the on side.
On a good length around off, Buttler hits it back towards the bowler.
Full and outside off, Buttler shoulders his arms to this.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Buttler pushes it to mid off.
Squares him up. Length ball on middle and leg. Stokes looks to play it with a straight bat but gets a leading edge towards the off side. They pick up a single.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Down the leg side, Buttler tries to flick it but misses.
Edged but safe. Bowled outside off, Stokes gets low to defend it but gets a small edge which flies past the slip fielder. They cross for a run.
Another floated ball on middle, Stokes prods forward and blocks it out.
Outside off this time, Stokes bunts it down onto the ground.
Another loopy ball on middle and leg, Stokes bunts it down.
Gives this air, bowls it slower in line of the stumps, Stokes blocks it out.
We are back for the last session of the day. Kohli has some final words in the huddle. Let's see how long they persist with Ashwin. For now, he will continue his spell.
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

Session Highlights - 26.1 overs, 60 runs, 2 wickets. It was a horrible beginning for England as Jonny Bairstow was found wanting on the very first ball from Mohammed Shami. India were charged up after that and bowled with good intensity. Joe Root was looking set for a big one but a momentary lapse in concentration resulted in him losing his wicket. After that, Jos Buttler joined Ben Stokes and both of them are looking in good shape, having swelled the lead to 125. The visitors would be disappointed with the way Ravichandran Ashwin has bowled, especially after what Moeen Ali produced on Day 2. The tourists need to get their act together or else the game will slip away from them. Join us shortly for the final session.
On a driveable length outside off, Buttler resists the temptation to allow it through. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 3!
Bumrah goes wider of the crease and angles in a back of a length ball. Jos punches it off the back foot to the cover region.
Wide outside off, ignored by Buttler.
Too full and straight, Buttler flicks it past the catching short mid-wicket fielder. There is some work for Pujara in the deep and he does well to keep it down to a couple.
Back of a length around off stump, dealt nicely from within the crease.
Length ball outside off, Jos doesn't fiddle with it.
Bumrah comes back to bowl the last over before Tea.
Full on off, kept out nicely.
150 up for England! Buttler allows the ball to spin in and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for an easy run.
Better from Ashwin! Gives this one more flight and gets it to beat the forward defense of Buttler to brush his pads and then dies down.
Short delivery, spinning in. Jos goes for the cut but misses. That was not far from the off pole.
Full delivery, whipped to the mid-wicket region again.
Low full toss, Buttler mistimes his heave towards short mid-wicket.
Shami attacks the stumps again by bowling it full, kept out confidently.

Aggression from Shami! Pitched up ball on off, driven straight back to him. He collects it and throws it as the batsman has to take evasive action. He apologizes immediately and Stokes has a smile on his face too. Good to see.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, Ben Stokes comes forward and blocks it with authority.
Full ball, straighter in line, tucked with a closed bat face towards mid-wicket.
Some reverse swing visible again as Buttler drives it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on and scurries across to the other end.
Well outside off, left alone.

Ooh! That one stayed a touch low and almost took the off stump. Lands around off and then spins away a touch. Stokes instead of coming forward tries to cut it away but he misses. Ashwin has a wry smile on his face. That was very close.
Nicely played by Ben! He kneels across to the tossed up ball and paddle sweeps it to fine leg for a brace.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length outside off, eased off the front foot towards covers.
Straighter one from Ashwin, Ben covers the line and presents a water-tight defense.
Quick again on middle and leg, kept out off the back foot.
Very full ball outside off, squeezed off the outer half through point for a run and Stokes will retain strike.
Fractionally overpitched on leg stump, tucked around the corner to rotate strike.
There is some movement near the sightscreen. A guy was coming in the sight of Buttler and he has been asked to move away.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This time Jos doesn't go fishing at this one. Lets the length ball outside off to hold its own course.

Shami is consistently troubling Buttler! There is some reverse swing which is working in his favour. Pitches on a length around off and comes in appreciably. Buttler tries to block it but gets beaten.
Short of a length outside off, Buttler initially shapes for the pull but adjusts at the last moment to push it towards mid on.
Lands this one on the rough patch and gets it to spin in sharply. Ben comes ahead to deal with it but the turn and extra bounce deceives him to hit him on the thigh pad.
On a shorter length, ample time for Ben to go back and work it through square leg to pick up a brace.

On a flatter trajectory and going straight on, Stokes defends it besides the pitch on the leg side. Ashwin is bowling pretty quick for anyone's liking. Needs to slow it down to extract more out of the pitch.
Floated around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Buttler allows the ball to come to him and plays this one against the spin through point for a run.
The leg spinner from around the wicket from Ashwin. Spinning in nicely. Stokes punches it through extra cover to rotate strike.
Back of a length ball around off, Buttler gets it off the outer half through cover-point. Some aggressive running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Shami switches his angle to around the wicket and bowls it on the hips, Stokes moves inside the line and turns it through backward square leg. A single taken.
On a length, too straight this time, clipped away with ease through backward square leg for a single.

Shami has gone past the outside edge of the wicket-keeper batsman once again. He steams in and bowls it in the avenue of apprehension. Buttler without much feet goes for a booming drive but misses. That was so close to the edge. Shami has his hands on his head.
Shami hits a good length but the line is well outside off as Jos leaves it alone.
On a length, angling in from outside off, Buttler camps back and blocks it with authority.
Stokes comes ahead to the loopy ball and dead-bats it.
Straying on the pads, turned around the corner for a run.

That was a very, very risky shot! With the rough area being present, Buttler has to be careful. Tossed up outside off, Jos goes for the drive but mistimes it, almost on the full to Ashwin. Lucky that it landed short.
Very full on middle and leg, patted to the leg side.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Bowls another one on the rough area and gets it to spin in a touch. Stokes tries to flick it away but gets struck on the thigh pad.
Makes use of the depth of the crease to the length ball and stonewalls it.
Full length ball, swinging in, kept out defensively to the leg side.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
FOUR! Bread and butter stuff for Buttler! Anything on his pads and he will put it away. Full on middle and leg, Jos flicks it nonchalantly through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Close shave! On a length around off, hits the deck hard and then seams away a touch. Buttler flirts with danger and almost falls prey to it.
Pitched up ball around off, driven crisply towards mid off.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
The leg spinner from the wily spinner. It is quicker in pace too as Stokes gets his bat down to keep it at bay.
That one didn't land on the rough area but it still spun away viciously. On middle and leg, Ben comes forward to block but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Stokes needs to be careful! Ashwin targets the rough patch outside the leg stump. It pitches there and spits away. Ben is able to pad it off.
Quicker from Ashwin, Stokes gets behind the line to keep it out.
Slower through the air outside off, Buttler eases it through covers to rotate strike.
Full ball outside off, left alone.

Easy pickings! Sharma tries to catch Buttler off guard by bowling it full but ends up overpitching it down the leg side. Buttler clips it nicely through mid-wicket. Dhawan cuts it off and saves a run for his side. England's lead has crossed 100 now.

FOUR! Did that carry? Probably not. The Indians have their tails up and are firing on all cylinders. Back of a length ball in the tight off stump channel, straightens a bit to square Buttler up. He has to play at it and gets an outside edge behind. Kohli at second slip gets low to his left but the ball drops in front of him and goes past to reach the fence.
Pitched up ball, Jos comes ahead and blocks it right under his eyes.
Another play and a miss! In the corridor of uncertainty, Buttler fishes at it again and gets foxed.
Good stuff from Sharma! He bowls this one on the fifth stump channel and gets it to move away a wee bit. Buttler pokes at it and almost edges it behind.
Maiden over. Off spinner on off, Stokes shoulders his arms to it.
On middle and leg, Stokes flicks it away to the on side.
Short ball down leg again, comes in sharply and goes away from Stokes. He pokes his bat out and gets a leading edge towards slip.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pitched outside leg, Stokes gets his pads out to see it off.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Stokes prods forward and blocks it out.
Jos Buttler is the new man in.

OUT! This can well turn out to be the defining moment of the game! Shami has caught the English skipper napping. The Indians are absolutely elated and why not! Fullish ball around off, Stokes taps it towards mid on and takes off. Root is a bit slow to react and Mohammed spots that. He takes some steps in, attacks the ball and fires a bullet to uproot the stumps at the keeper's end as Joe tries to drag his bat in. The visitors are already celebrating as Root has an anxious look on his face. He walks towards his partner gingerly and his body language is not confident. Time for the replays. Well, they show that the batsman is well short of his crease. England are ahead by 95 runs but have lost half their side too.
What a terrific piece of fielding from Shami as he scored a direct hit at the striker's end! Root was not expecting that and he may find himself in trouble. Looks like a goner.
Shaping away from the southpaw, Ben doesn't fiddle with it.
FOUR! Beautiful stroke! Fractionally overpitched, Stokes comes forward and strokes it with a straight bat down the ground for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

A huge, huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down! But what a nut from Ishant Sharma, he outfoxed the batsman there. He bowls a full and fast inswinger around leg stump. Stokes loses his balance as his bat comes down at an angle and he is rapped on the pads. Ishant is pleading but the umpire doesn't give a positive response. Kohli from the slip cordon looks at his bowler, thinks about the DRS but doesn't go for it. Wise call as the replays roll in later and show that it pitched outside leg.
On a length around off, Ben hangs back and taps it nicely towards mid off.
Quicker and shorter outside off, Root tries to glide it to third man but first slip intercepts.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good one from Ash! Slips in the carrom ball around off and gets it to spin in nicely. Ben reads it off the pitch and defends it late.
Gives this one more revs and bowls it flatter outside off, Stokes knows where his off stump is and makes an assured leave.
Lands this one just a touch outside off, Ben puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Tossed up fullish ball around off, kept out watchfully.

Drinks break. India started off in flying form with Mohammed Shami dismissing the dangerous Jonny Bairstow on the first ball itself. Post that, skipper Joe Root and Ben Stokes have shored things up a bit and need to continue on. The pacers are doing the best they can, but Ravichandran Ashwin needs to do more. He's trying too much, so just has to keep it simple, as he's crucial to India's chances in this game.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short of a good length around that off pole, the batsman jumps and keeps it down safely.
Full delivery just outside off, Joe Root goes across and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Fires it down the leg side, an attempted flick shot from the captain misses.
Length delivery in the off stump channel, pitches and goes away late, Root goes for the drive and is beaten all ends up.
Fullish from Ishant, blocked in front of the cover region.
Stokes has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes forward and blocks again.
Loopy and slow on middle and leg, Stokes gets his front leg out of the way and defends getting close to the pitch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the leg stump line, it's turned down towards short fine leg for nothing.
A little too full from Ashwin, darts it in quicker too, Stokes easily deals with it. Needs to give it a lot more flight, Ashwin. Has to give himself a chance.

Ooohh! Root was expecting that one to come in but ever so rarely, Ishant Sharma makes it go the other way. This was one such occasion and Root almost got undone because of it. Left his bat hanging and nearly edged it behind. Good end to the over from the pacer.
Steps out of the crease and wrists the length ball in front of square leg for a run.
Deft from Stokes. Nicely done. Sees the movement away, waits for the ball to come and plays it at the last second. Opens the face and runs it down towards third man. A brace is collected.
Too far outside off, full in length, arms are shouldered to that one.
Takes a step out of the crease as it's landed shorter, it's going across and Ben lets it go.
Hurls this across Stokes, on a bit of a fuller length, the all-rounder lets it be for Pant to collect.
Some room on offer outside off, Joe plays this late and dabs it past the keeper. Short third man chases it down as the batsmen take two.
Quicker through the air, on the stumps, defended right under his nose.
Sliding in on a shorter length from around the wicket, Stokes works it through mid-wicket for three good runs.
Plays with the spin and turns it away square on the leg side for a single.
The straighter one from Ashwin and Root is beaten. The English skipper plays for the turn when there is none and the ball as a result goes past the outside edge.
Spinning in from off, Root plays it down in front of short leg.
Back with spin now as Ravichandran Ashwin returns to the attack. A slip, a leg gully and a short leg in place for him.
Angling across from a fullish length, Stokes makes a watchful leave.
Too straight on the pads and Root puts this away easily. Flicks it down to fine leg and takes one.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Just around off, on the same length, pushed defensively in front of covers.
Too far from the off stick, Joe doesn't bother with it.
Full in length and attacking the off stump, blocked.
Ishant Sharma comes on.
Just ahead of a length around off, blocked off the front foot.

India are appealing for a catch but the umpire remains unmoved. Back of a length around off, Stokes has a feel for it and as soon as Pant catches it, Rahane goes up in a loud appeal. He's sure Ben has nicked it. Kohli joins in, they ponder but don't review it as such. Though, replays show there might have been a feather on it. But Snicko later clears it up as it shows no spike.
Nicely done. Short of a length, tapped square through point for one.
Length ball on the stumps, Root meets it with a defensive bat in response.
Speared in full again, on off this time, Joe flicks it towards short mid-wicket again.
Full and fired in on middle, angling in, Root flicks it right off the middle straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Just outside off, slanting away, Stokes taps it down in front of point but won't get any run for it.
Good length delivery on the fifth stump channel, left alone.
Flicks it away with a wristy shot on the leg side. A single is taken.
On the shorter side of the length, another defensive shot on offer.

Superb! Mohammed Shami looks boosted with those two wickets either side of the break. Lands a length delivery just outside off and there's a hint of away movement. Root is seduced to feel for it and almost edges it behind. So close.
Back of a length outside off, tapped down in front of cover.

This is probing stuff from Bumrah! He lands this one in the corridor of uncertainty and surprises Ben. He is in two minds whether to come forward or to stay back. Is caught in a tangle and somehow fends it off from the bottom half of the bat.
On the fifth stump channel, left alone.
Ben Stokes walks down the track to unsettle Bumrah but the pacer is cool as a cucumber. He attacks the stumps with a length ball and goes past the defense of the southpaw to rap him on the thigh pad.
Serves this one a bit wider and fuller outside off, Stokes is not drawn into an ambitious stroke.
A pacy length ball outside off, holding its line. Ben plants his front foot across and allows it through.
Well bowled! This one takes off after landing on a good length around off. Stokes is taken aback but does well to keep it out down the track.
Good ball. Length delivery on off, it's defended back down the track to the bowler.
Angling in on middle and leg and then starts to seam away, Root stays behind the line and works it down on the leg side.
Wide outside off, Joe covers the line, gets his bat out of the way and leaves it alone.
Fuller in length just outside off, driven crisply through covers for a couple.
Just outside off, rising from a good length, Root gets on top of the ball and defends it down on the off side.
FOUR! This is a good shot. Anything on the pads and Root will put it away. Picks up the length ball with ease and places it through square leg for a boundary.
Remains in the crease and blocks it out with a straight blade.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length around off, kept out off the back foot.
Ben Stokes is having a change of bats.
Bumrah hits the deck hard and serves it on a back of a length. It comes to Stokes at a good pace. He stands inside the crease and blocks it out.
Good length delivery just outside off, holding its line, pushed back down the track off the back foot.
Shortish delivery into the body, Stokes fends it away awkwardly off the glove down on the leg side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A mild appeal for lbw, turned down. Height clearly the issue. Just behind a length, angling back in, Stokes looks to work it on the leg side but is caught high on the thigh pad.
Angling down leg, too wide for Stokes to make any contact.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, from around the wicket, Stokes gets behind the line and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Waits for the length ball to come to him and runs it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! No hat-trick for Shami. Back of a length outside off, Root stands tall and punches this off the outer half through gully. The fielder chases it down but can't stop it, even with a dive.
Outside off, Stokes is happy to leave it alone.
Outside off, Stokes is not enticed to play at it.
Joe has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a good length shaping away, Root plays at it and gets beaten.

Long appeal but the height has saved him. Comes in from over the wicket and lands this on a good length around off. Root comes across and looks to bunt this down. The ball moves in and hits him on his thigh pad. They appeal but the umpire stays put. India think of the review but opt against it. Good call again as the replay shows us that the ball would have just clipped the bails.
Ben Stokes is the new man in. Also, Jasprit Bumrah will bowl from the other end.

OUT! What a cracker! Absolute beauty! Mohammed Shami has got two in two and castled Jonny Bairstow. What has he had for lunch? Feed him some more. Comes in from over the wicket and hurls it on a fuller length on middle and leg. Bairstow looks to play at it with a straight bat but is beaten all ends up. The ball brushes his pads and goes on to uproot the stumps. Not the ball you want first up if you're a batsman. Shami will be on a hat-trick in his next over.

We are back for our post-Lunch session. Jonny Bairstow and Joe Root walk to the middle. The players take the field. Virat Kohli continues chirping some words to the players. Mohammed Shami will finish his over.
... Day 3, Second Session ...

India started off with spin straightaway. The rough was aiding Ashwin but didn't get wickets to show for it. The pacers couldn't do much as the ball was not moving like it did in the first innings but they shared the wickets among themselves. The visitors will be happy with the last wicket and now they will look to get few more quick ones. England should not worry too much as they bat deep and already have a 65-run lead. If they get anywhere close to the 200-mark, that should put them in the front seat. Join us soon for the second session of the day.

It was England's session till the last ball but Jennings' wicket will have changed the equation. Not tilted the favor but maintained the balance. England started off well with Cook and Jennings. The openers didn't get the runs but were wise in their approach. Cook fell later and Moeen's promotion up the order didn't work, courtesy a great catch from KL Rahul. Root and Jennings stitched a good 59-run stand but a beauty from Shami meant India can digest their lunch better.

OUT! Plumb! There were no two thoughts about it. I don't know what was the review about. Shami comes in from round the wicket and hurls this full and around off. The ball comes back in and hits Jennings on the back leg who is beaten through his defense. Shami appeals while celebrating and the umpire raises his finger. Keaton after a long chat with his partner takes it up. Replays show us three reds and Keaton can have his lunch in his own time.
LBW review. Looks out! Jennings has reviewed but it's going to go in vain. He looks like a dead duck.
FOUR! No third man and Keaton gets another boundary to his name. This will boost his confidence. Full and outside off, Jennings cuts it towards the third man region for a boundary.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full and on off, Jennings defends it from inside the crease.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside leg again, Jennings defends it with his pads.
Full and around off, Jennings prods forward and blocks it.
Pitched outside leg, Jennings blocks it with his pads.
Cut away and cut away nicely. Waits for it and cuts it late through the backward point region. The ball does not go all the way but they come back for the third.
Short ball on off, Root defends it off his back foot.
Jennings works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full again in line off the stumps, Root taps it in front of him.
Outside off, left alone.
Punched off the back foot by Keaton. They pick up a single to bring up the 50-run stand between the two. Good rebuilding stuff from the duo.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Another appeal, another one given against India. Shami hurls this around off, the ball comes back in sharply. Root is caught off balance and gets hit on his back pad. India appeal to no avail. They think of the review but opt not to take it. Another good call, as the replay shows us that would have gone over the stumps.
FOUR! Class! Overpitched ball in line of the stumps, Root drives it along the turf straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
KJ defends it from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Leg bye! Long and loud appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. Perhaps going down the leg side. Pitches it on the rough, the ball spins into Root. He misses his flick and gets hit on his pads. Ashwin and Co. appeal but the umpire stays put. India think of the review but decide against it. Good decision from Kohli as the replay shows us that it would have gone down leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, Root reads the spin and leaves it alone.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Joe has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Gets it in the gap this time. Good length ball outside off, Root waits for it and cuts it late through the gully area for a boundary.
Length ball in line of the stumps, Root plays it with a straight bat.
Short and wide outside off, Root cuts it hard but finds the man at backward point.
Fuller this time on off, Root sees it off.
Good ball. Nips back in which causes Root trouble. Shami hurls it on a good length around off, the ball comes back in and takes Root by surprise. Hits him outside off on his pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish ball on off, Jennings looks solid in defense. He is lucky the rough is not close to the left-hander's off stump.
Loopy ball around off, Jennings hits it towards the bowler with ease.
Hangs back and punches this ball to the off side.
Beauty! Nice flight and turn on that one. Jennings looks to block this but is beaten by the turn.
Full and around off, Jennings plays that off his front foot.
Another length ball around off, Root stays inside and blocks it.
Full in line of the stumps, Root bunts it down.
Loose shot from Root. Shami hurls this on a good length outside off. The ball moves away a bit. Root looks to cut this away but cannot get bat to ball.
Length ball on off, Jennings punches the ball through point for a single.
Full and outside off, easy leave for Jennings.
Starts off with a length ball on the pads of Keaton who tucks it away to the on side.
Mohammed Shami is called into the attack.
The batsman tried to sweep that one but missed it and was hit on the pads.
FOUR! Great shot! Loopy ball around off, Root gets on one knee, brings out the broom and sweeps this through square leg all the way to the fence.
Floated ball on off, Root rocks back and bunts this down.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Off spinner around off, Root flicks it away.
Darted around off, Root blocks it out.
Jennings shoulders arms to let that one through.
Keaton defends it from within the crease.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR BYES! Nothing Pant can do about it. Short and down the leg side from Bumrah. Root ducks under it, the ball moves away from the batsman. Pant moves to his left but cannot get any glove to it. The ball runs to the fine leg boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
In the air... but well ahead. Jennings brings out the swipe again. Gets a top edge which flies over short fine leg. The fielder there hares to the ball and keeps it to two.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Jennings. He is looking in different form today. Gets low and sweeps this ball through square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Great improvisation. Premeditates and gets a boundary off it. Ashwin darts this on leg, Jennings reverse sweeps this through third man for a boundary.
KJ has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Sweet! Pitched up ball on off, Root leans ahead and drives it neatly through covers for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

NOT OUT! Poor review from India. Back of a length ball outside off, Root goes back and tries to block it. Misses it and gets hit on his pads. India appeal but the umpire is not interested. Kohli has a chat with the bowler and takes it up. Replays show that the ball is missing the top of the stumps. India lose a review.
Review time! Root is the man in the picture. Nobody looks really confident.
Back of a length ball outside off, Root rocks back and cuts it through point. Will get two runs for it.
Darts this quicker and full on off, blocked after coming on the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Gives this some air around off, a front foot block from the batsman.
Quick, flat and outside off, slaps the punch to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed behind point after reaching out for it. The fielder chases it down and two runs are taken.
Full and outside off, Jennings shoulders his arms to it.
Length outside off, Jennings plays it with a straight bat.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Misses his line and pays the price for it. Bumrah serves this on the pads, Jennings just helps it on its way towards the fine leg region for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on leg, Jennings looks to tuck it away but gets hit on his thigh pad.
Length ball outside off, well blocked.
Change of ends for Jasprit Bumrah.
Loopy ball outside off, Root looks to slog sweep this but gets it off the bottom edge onto his pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
That's the rough the spinners will look for. Ashwin lands it on that area close to the right-hander. Root goes back and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Nicely done. Ashwin gives this air on middle and leg. Root flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, Root taps it in front of him.

Drinks are on the field. A good first hour for India. They've managed to nab a couple of wickets in the form of Cook and Ali with Bumrah and Ishant getting a wicket apiece. The ball isn't moving much, but it's doing just enough. Root and Jennings have to see the session out. A good phase awaits in the next hour for us.
Slanting across on a length outside off, Keaton makes an easy leave.
Second warning for Ishant. He steps in the danger zone once again. Strike three and he's out. So, being cautious, he switches to over the wicket.
Outside off on a good length, left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Joe camps back and punches the short ball through the covers. One run to the total.
Bangs it in short into the body, Jennings swivels and helps the pull down to fine leg for one.
Sharma keeps steaming in and bowls it on a back of a length on off, Jennings leans across to get behind the line and blocks.
On the fourth stump line, a good length delivery and Root leaves it alone.
Short and wide outside off, Root stays back and pushes it to backward point. Can't get it past the fielder there.
Well outside off, left alone.
Shortish delivery angling across, Jennings shifts his weight onto the back foot and punches it square through the off side for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slanting away from a good length, outside off, the line is covered and then left alone.
Moves inside the line and works it away on the leg side. End of a good, testing and successful over from Sharma.
Good length delivery on off stump, Root hangs inside the crease and lets it be.
Joe Root, the captain, makes his way out in the middle.

OUT! Got 'em! The catch is clean according to the TV umpire and Moeen Ali is out of here. The move to send him up the order hasn't worked out. Lovely delivery from Ishant Sharma. Uses that round the wicket angle so well. Angles it in at first and then makes it go away. Moeen Ali has no choice but to put bat on ball as it's dangerously close to the off stump. The edge is drawn and it goes behind towards Rahul at second slip. He dives low to his right, takes it and celebrates. The umpire, however, isn't sure if the catch is clean and refers it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that there's no problem, Rahul got his fingers underneath and Moeen is out of here.
Moeen Ali has been caught behind in the slips. Though, the umpire isn't sure if the catch is taken cleanly or not by KL Rahul. It's taken upstairs and the soft signal is out.
Just ahead of a length, outside off and shaping away, Ali is forced into the drive and he misses it completely.
Cutting in on middle and leg, catches the all-rounder on the thigh pad as he tries to play bat on ball.
Banged in short, ducked and evaded.
Short of a good length on middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Banged in short, kept out off the back foot.

FOUR! Length delivery, on off, Ali brings his bat down to play but the ball takes the outer portion and flies through the vacant gully region for a boundary. Kohli doesn't like that one bit, expect him to plug that area up soon.
Going across again, on a good length, no shot offered on that.

Bumrah keeps pushing it across Moeen. There are three slips in place and a widish backward point along with them. Moeen comes forward to drive the full ball and gets it off the outer half to Pandya in the latter position.
Better from Ishant. Going to have to make him play, but that's much better. Length delivery around off, shapes away as it's left alone.
Similar line, similar length. Same shot, same result.
Ishant Sharma has been given an official warning for stepping in the middle of the pitch. Going to have to be careful now.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Outside the line of off stump, Keaton does not flirt with it.
Banged in short, left alone.
In the corridor of uncertainty from around the wicket, Jennings has nothing to do with it.
Length delivery which rises off the deck, another defensive shot offered in response.
Stays right behind the line and defends it out.

Absolute beauty from Bumrah. Has been a superb over so far. Could argue that he might need to just go that tad fuller like he did to Cook, but it's been great nonetheless. Just behind a length around off, going across, Moeen Ali tries to play at it but misses.

FOUR! Streaky runs but they are runs. ENGLAND TAKE THE LEAD BY 1 RUN. Back of a length outside off, Ali is in two minds about what to do with this. Ends up trying to leave it but gets it off the edge. It falls short and gets through the slip cordon for a boundary.

Oh how close! That was a jaffa. How has that missed? Moeen Ali would have been waiting for the noise. Bumrah has his arms up in the air and he's shocked. Everyone is. Dear me. An excellent delivery on a length, just around off and it nips back in ever so slightly. Goes just past the inside edge as Ali looks to block and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
Moeen Ali walks in at no.3. His natural position in county cricket. Can he make a difference with this promotion in a familiar position?

OUT! Bumrah strikes! It's Alastair Cook he gets this time. A full delivery going across, perfect length for Cook as he's drawn into the cover drive. He plays away from his body and a thick edge results. It flies to KL Rahul at second slip, who can't take it on the first go. Juggles a couple of times but eventually holds on to it. India have their first breakthrough. England trail by 3 runs.

That late leave could have nearly cost him. Sharma brings it in closer to the off stump on a length, Jennings raises his bat late to let it pass. It could have gone off the bottom half/under edge for a catch behind. A bit lazy, that.
Goes square of the wicket. It's shorter in length, there's some room on offer for Cook. He camps back and pushes it through point to get over to the other end.
On the sixth stump line, no way Alastair will play at it.
Too straight from Sharma and too full as well, flicked neatly through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket area for a double.

Almost. Ishant nearly gets his man. Comes steaming in and spears this full. Angles it in, looking for the late movement away. Doesn't happen as much as he'd like it to and Cook gets it off the leading edge to mid off, after closing the face early to flick.
Angling in on off before straightening up a shade, Alastair Cook shapes up to defend and keeps it down on the track beside him on the off side.
Too straight in line, Keaton picks it off his hips and works it to short fine leg.
Hurled outside the line of off stump, left alone.
Beaten! Good bowling. Jennings almost goes fishing but withdraws just in time. Back of a length slanting across, whizzes just past the edge of the bat.

Back to over the wicket. It's full on off, Keaton drives it tamely to mid off. Bumrah is going to have to be quite calculative with his plans here. The ball isn't moving as much it did in the first innings, so needs to use the rough areas to his advantage.

FOUR! Bumrah switches to around the wicket and instantly gets hammered for a boundary. Length delivery with width outside off, Jennings cuts this through the vacant gully position and finds the fence.
Back of a length on middle and leg, clipped into the leg side for an easy run.
Jasprit Bumrah comes into the bowling attack. He was the one who dismissed Jennings in the first innings. A repeat on the cards? Three slips in position.
Alastair Cooks moves inside the line as he sees the ball coming in on the leg stump line, and whips it down towards fine leg for a single.
Hits the deck hard, a back of a length ball on middle and off which skids off the surface somewhat, worked away from the inner half behind square leg. Brisk single stolen.
Outside off on a good length, he doesn't fiddle with it. Lets it go as Pant collects it.
Short of a good length but it's on a tight line, Jennings remains rooted inside the crease and blocks it out.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, arms are shouldered to this one.
Ishant keeps this full and around off, it comes in first and then shapes away, Jennings plays this off the outer half, square towards point.
The leg break from Ashwin, comes a long way in from outside off, Cook covers the line and offers no shot.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Too far outside off, no shot offered from the batsman.
Overpitched on off, drilled straight to the man at cover.
Quite slow through the air, on a driving length, Jennings watches the ball closely as he allows it through.
Fires it right up there, met with a straight bat in defense.
Back of a length around off, Cook stays back and hits it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
Length ball in line of the stumps, Cook hops and taps it in front of him.
Hint of swing. Sharma bowls this full and outside off, it ball moves away a bit. Cook is happy to shoulder his arms to it.

FOUR! First boundary of the morning. Overpitched from Sharma on middle and leg. Cook gets behind the ball and flicks it with force through the gap of mid-wicket. The ball races to the boundary. The umpire signals four runs.
Full on middle and leg, flicked away to square leg.
Good from Ash. Too much spin on this occasion. Spins into Keaton who goes back to block it but gets hit on his back leg. The players appeal but that was going down leg.
Another one given air on that fourth stump channel, KJ is solid in his defense.
First runs of the morning for Keaton Jennings. Takes a step and drives this floated ball through covers for a brace.
Loopy ball outside off, Keaton prods forward and plays it onto the ground.
Tossed up on middle and off, Jennings gets forward and bunts this.
This one comes back in, Ashwin bowls it around off, Jennings goes back and blocks it.
On the shorter side of the length, blocked again.
Angles in at first and then straightens up after hitting the deck, the former English Test skipper shapes up for it before defending it down on the off side.
Back of a length outside off, with an open face it's pushed square to point. Dot ball.
Keeps slightly low as Ishant attacks the off stick, the southpaw does well to bring his blade down in time and block.
Lands it on a good length, on the fourth stump line, pushed out gently with a straight blade.
Short of a good length from around the wicket, Alastair Cook hangs back and keeps it out.
Ishant Sharma will run in from the other end.
End of the first over on Day 3. Ashwin floats it up just outside off, Jennings comes well forward, covers the line and lets it past him.
First run of the day. Cook flicks this just past short mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Sliding in on the pads, tucked away with soft hands.
Looped up and pitched outside off, it's left alone.
Drags the length back but keeps it in line of the stumps, Cook goes back and works it down on the leg side.
Starts from around the wicket and tosses it up on off, Cook takes a big lunge forward and blocks it out.

We are ready to get underway. The series hangs in the balance for Virat Kohli and his army, so a good start today becomes all the more important for them. Alastair Cook and Keaton Jennings stride out to take their place in the middle, while the Indians spread out across the field. Not totally unexpected, with two left-handers and a dry surface, Ravichandran Ashwin is handed the ball first. Two slips and a short leg in place for him. Let's roll...

Pitch Report - Sanjay Manjrekar out in the middle reckons the rough areas have a new dimension. Feels that till now, Moeen Ali was more equipped to use them than Ravichandran Ashwin. Adds that even the pacers, like Jasprit Bumrah can utilize this as he hits the deck outside off and makes it come back in, much like Ishant Sharma. States it's a decent batting track, but the bowlers will have something in it for them, both the seamers and spinners.

Such is the beauty of Test match cricket. The game is very much in the balance, don't let the circumstances fool you. It could go either way, depending on how this morning pans out. If the English top order can hold steady, things could sway in their favor. Similarly, if India pick up a few early wickets, well... you get the gist. All poised to be spectacular. Hang in there, play will begin in the blink of an eye.

Hello and welcome, everyone, for what's going to be a gripping Test match. The first two days displayed some entertaining battles throughout and both teams mounted a fight. The bowling has been good in the series so far, but with the addition of good batting performances, things are getting highly exciting. The top order of respective teams were rolled over, but the lower order showed good resistance and exceeded expectations. It was Sam Curran for England first with the bat, followed by Cheteshwar Pujara who scored his first ton in England.
... Day 3, First Session ...

There are a lot of rough areas on the track and from the looks of things, the pitch will take some considerable amount of turn come the new day. India will try and wrap up England ASAP. More so than any other reason because the hosts have two spinners, while the tourists have just the one. The morning session on Day 3 will be key in terms of a psychological edge. So join us at 1100 local (1000 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

So, like the first day, we've had exactly 4 overs after a team has been bowled out. Another exciting day of Test cricket comes to a close. The two English openers managed to survive Jasprit Bumrah and Ravichandran Ashwin's onslaught and head back to the dressing room unscathed. The day had genius with both bat and ball, with Cheteshwar Pujara's hundred and Moeen Ali's 5-fer standing out amongst everything.
Bumrah spears it outside off, the angle is taking it away and Jennings knows this. He raises his bat and lets it go past him. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Well left. He looked at that till the last moment. The swing away from the batsman from around off, left alone.

Oh deary me! What a ripper! Had Jennings got out to that, nobody would have blamed him. Superb from Bumrah. Pitches it on middle and gets it to move away late. That squares Keaton Jennings up and he hangs his bat out to dry. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
Goes for the yorker as he targets the off stick, Jennings opens the face and squeezes it to gully.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
FOUR! Falters with the line and pays the price. Bumrah bowls it on the pads, Jennings flicks it fine down the leg side and gets a boundary for doing so.
Shorter and quicker, around off, blocked off the back foot.
Spinning away from around off, left alone.
Skidding off the surface, shorter again, kept out on the leg side.
Shortens the length a lot more, too short and Cook goes back to punch it down in front of silly point.
Better. Drags the length back ever so slightly and pitches it around off, turns away as Cook just about pushes it down square on the off side.
Drifting in from around the wicket, full on off, Alastair presses forward and dead-bats it.

Almost got him there. Fuller in length on middle and leg, it shapes away slightly and squares Cook up. It goes off the leading edge through covers and a single is taken. A scare survived, but another over has ticked by and that's all England will care about.
Well down the leg side, an attempted flick is missed.
It comes back in finally. The line is good but the length needs to be fuller. Cook is a good player and anything even a fraction short won't bother him. He stays inside the crease and pushes it away.
Serves it on a length on middle and off, moves away again, Alastair Cook shoulders his arms to it.
Lands it on leg and it moves a long way towards off, Cook is right behind the line to block.
Slanting across from a good length, outside off, Cook is watchful as he lets this one go past him.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end.
Positions himself right behind the line as he keeps it out.
Darted well outside off, Keaton has nothing to do with it.
Quicker through the air again but it's a touch shorter in length, defended in front of short leg.
Quicker and shorter outside off, punched off the back foot to the same fielder.
A bit slower through the air, on a driving length and outside off, Jennings is well forward as he pushes this to short cover.
Off the mark immediately. Ashwin comes from around the wicket and slides it in on middle and leg, Alastair Cook goes back and wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
